big_case.notes: Third emergency application in the Venezuela TPS litigation: the immigration status and work authorisation of several hundred thousand people, and (per the application) roughly 1,800 detainees, turned on whether the district court's judgment stayed on hold. Stakes are high in human and operational terms. Tempered because the governing legal question was largely settled by Mullin v. Doe before this application, and because the application was withdrawn a day after filing without the Court acting, so it produced no ruling.

leakage.notes: Forward cell (log mode forward; prediction created 2026-11-19 ~14:3x-14:5xZ). The outcome is a withdrawal docketed Nov 19 2026; the withdrawal letter's docket filename carries a 2026-11-19 15:55 stamp, later in the day than the prediction. No retrieved_doc_date on or after resolution, no read of data/qp-topics, and the reasoning treats the application as pending. Every call is outcome_only (coverage 0.0), so calls are graded on their queries. They include a fetch of the live 26A714 docket JSON, which the reasoning reports as showing only the Nov 18 submission, and CourtListener reads of the Ninth Circuit docket including an order entered there on Nov 18 (DE 109). That order is a lower-court development predating resolution, not this application's disposition: legitimate forward signal, honestly disclosed.
